purpose.zh: 臀部抬着，脚跟推出去再拉回来，练大腿后侧
purpose.en: Keep your hips up and slide your heels out and back to work the back of your thighs.

text.zh: 臀部抬高别掉，脚跟慢慢推出再拉回
text.en: Keep your hips high, slowly slide your heels out, then curl them back

text.zh: 仰卧抬臀，脚跟踩在滑盘上。
text.en: Lie on your back, lift your hips and rest your heels on the sliders.

text.zh: 拉回时脚跟回到膝盖下方，臀部夹紧。
text.en: Pull your heels back under your knees and squeeze your glutes.

commonErrors.en: Letting the hips drop to the floor.

cautions.zh: 大腿后侧容易抽筋，抽筋时先停下休息
cautions.en: The backs of your thighs may cramp; if they do, stop and rest.

changes: 口令与动画不对应（原顶点「拉回」、结束「夹紧」）：改成推出-稳住-拉回
purpose 去掉「伸髋/屈膝」术语
caution 去掉「离心」改口语短句
